scientific_intent.scientific_task: Compress opaque binary64 bit patterns with warp-cooperative predictive unsigned deltas, sign/byte-count nibbles and compact per-chunk payloads; verify exact lossless recovery.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: For each 32-value group, unsigned delta = abs(current_bits - predictor_bits); encode sign and byte length in 4-bit header (length2 maps3), emit little-endian delta bytes; next predictors repeat previous group final dim values.
accuracy_requirements: Every full payload byte, absolute offset, hole sentinel and guard exact against independent sequential encoder
160 CPU decoder round trips recover every original UInt64 bit, including exceptional IEEE64 encodings
All4224 actual input/parameter prefix values exact; dual CUDA/CUDA.jl comparisons all5 trials, no tolerance
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: N512,8 chunks of64 values,4 blocks×2 warps,dimensions1/2/3/32,two fixtures,R3; original64million/255blocks×8warps/R100 excluded
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Source-backed primitive for lossless scientific data storage and reference-quality assurance; no production compression scalability claim.
